title: Outbox relay

sections.body: He built a relay that publishes events written in the same transaction as the change.
Events published after the commit were lost when the process died in between.
An outbox table, a relay that claims rows and a publisher with confirms.
Change data capture was considered and rejected as one more piece of infrastructure.
Claiming rows with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` keeps several relays from colliding.

questions: How does the outbox relay avoid losing events?
